full_text_en:
Huitong Sub-branch v. Fulida Company — Dispute over Usufruct Mortgage Contract

Plaintiff: Bank of Communications Harbin Branch Huitong Sub-branch.

Person in charge: Zhu Bohua, President.

Agents ad litem: Chen Huaiqing, Wang Guoyun, staff of Bank of Communications Harbin Branch Huitong Sub-branch.

Defendant: Harbin Fulida Public Facilities Co., Ltd. of Heilongjiang Province.

Legal representative: Li Baojun, General Manager.

Plaintiff's Allegations

The plaintiff alleged: The defendant borrowed RMB 6,100,000 and USD 1,000,000 from our sub-branch, and provided as loan mortgage guarantee its management right and leasing right over the Fulida Underground Commercial City. After the loan matured, despite repeated demands by our sub-branch, the defendant still owes the principal and part of the interest. We request the court to order the defendant to repay the loan principal and interest. If the defendant is unable to repay, it shall transfer the management right and leasing right over the Fulida Underground Commercial City to our sub-branch for exercise as agreed, and shall bear the litigation costs of this case.

Defendant did not file a defense.

Facts Found by the Heilongjiang High People's Court

On October 31, 1995, Defendant Fulida Company, for the purpose of renovating the Fulida Underground Commercial City, entered into two loan contracts with Plaintiff Huitong Sub-branch, stipulating: Huitong Sub-branch shall lend to Fulida Company RMB 6,100,000 and USD 1,000,000 respectively. Interest on the RMB loan shall be calculated at a monthly interest rate of 10.98‰, and interest on the USD loan shall be calculated at an annual interest rate of 7.2%. The loan terms were 4 months and 5 months respectively. The parties also entered into two mortgage contracts at the same time, stipulating: Fulida Company shall guarantee these two loans by mortgaging its management right and leasing right over the Fulida Underground Commercial City (area 10,000 square meters). On the date of signing, Huitong Sub-branch disbursed the loans of RMB 6,100,000 and USD 1,000,000 to Fulida Company in three installments. After these loans matured, Huitong Sub-branch only recovered interest of RMB 113,862.60 and USD 11,243.84. As of September 20, 1997, Fulida Company owed Huitong Sub-branch loan principal of RMB 6,100,000 and USD 1,000,000, and interest of RMB 1,726,128.3 and USD 146,860.28. Huitong Sub-branch therefore initiated this lawsuit.

It was further found that: The Fulida Underground Commercial City (area 11,178 square meters), located in the northwest of the square in front of Harbin Railway Station, is an underground facility constructed by the relevant department of the Harbin Municipal People's Government. During the construction process, Defendant Fulida Company's predecessor, Harbin Taihe Jewelry Co., Ltd., invested approximately RMB 50,000,000 in participation. The relevant department of the Harbin Municipal People's Government accordingly issued a document in 1993 determining: The ownership of this facility belongs to the State; Fulida Company has a long-term right to use, manage, and lease the portion it invested in. The relevant department of the municipal people's government expressed consent to the transfer to another party, for exercise, of the long-term management right and leasing right over the Fulida Underground Commercial City due to the current obligor's inability to perform its debts.

Opinion of the Heilongjiang High People's Court

The two loan contracts entered into between Plaintiff Huitong Sub-branch and Defendant Fulida Company comply with the provisions of the Loan Contract Regulations and are lawful and valid. Fulida Company's failure to repay the matured loans constitutes a breach of contract. Pursuant to Article 16 of the Loan Contract Regulations, it shall bear the responsibility of repaying the loans and interest.

The subject matter of the guarantee contract agreed upon by the parties in this case is the long-term management right and leasing right enjoyed by Fulida Company over the Fulida Underground Commercial City, which are usufruct rights. Among the provisions of the Guaranty Law of the PRC concerning "mortgage and mortgaged property," the property used for mortgage is generally property owned by the mortgagor. Fulida Company is not the owner of the Fulida Underground Commercial City and has no right to dispose of this immovable property. What it mortgaged to Huitong Sub-branch is only the long-term management right and leasing right over the Fulida Underground Commercial City. However, the long-term management right and leasing right enjoyed by the company over the Fulida Underground Commercial City are property rights that can bring benefits to the obligee, and the exercise of such rights can fully achieve the purpose of ensuring debt performance. Using such usufruct rights for mortgage, although the Guaranty Law does not expressly permit, it also does not expressly prohibit. Moreover, the owner of the Fulida Underground Commercial City has consented to the transfer of the usufruct rights arising from such mortgage. This situation is similar to the provision in Article 34 of the Guaranty Law that "the right to use barren land that is contracted according to law and mortgaged with the consent of the party granting the contract" may be mortgaged. Pursuant to Articles 4, 7, and 55 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the PRC, the usufruct mortgage contract entered into between Fulida Company and Huitong Sub-branch on the basis of voluntariness, fairness, and exchange of equal values reflects true intent, does not violate legal provisions, and does not harm the State, public interests, or the lawful rights and interests of others; therefore, it shall be a valid contract.

Pursuant to Article 53 of the Guaranty Law, Plaintiff Huitong Sub-branch, in the event that Defendant Fulida Company fails to perform its repayment obligation within the time limit, has the right to be satisfied from the value of the mortgaged property converted into monetary value or from the proceeds from auction or sale of such mortgaged property. Article 43 of the Guaranty Law provides: "Where a party mortgages other property, it may voluntarily register the mortgaged property, and the mortgage contract shall become effective as of the date of signing. If the parties fail to register the mortgaged property, such failure shall not be set up against a third party." The mortgage contract entered into by the parties in this case was not registered for the mortgage right. If any other mortgagee claims satisfaction from the same mortgaged property, satisfaction shall be made in accordance with the order provided in Article 43 and Article 54 of the Guaranty Law.

In conclusion, the Heilongjiang High People's Court, on December 16, 1997, rendered the following judgment:

1. Within ten days after this judgment takes effect, Defendant Fulida Company shall repay Plaintiff Huitong Sub-branch the loan principal of RMB 6,100,000 and USD 1,000,000, and pay interest of RMB 1,726,128.3 and USD 146,860.28 (interest calculated as of September 20, 1997); interest for the period until this judgment takes effect shall be calculated according to the agreement of the parties.

2. If Defendant Fulida Company fails to perform the judgment within the time limit, the usufruct rights over the Fulida Underground Commercial City mortgaged by Fulida Company shall be converted into monetary value, or the proceeds from auction or sale of such usufruct rights shall be used to compensate Huitong Sub-branch.

Court acceptance fee: RMB 82,060, to be borne by Defendant Fulida Company.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, neither party appealed.
